description: Persistent composed OpenUSD underground mine/drift for physical-AI failure research.

roof_support.mechanism: A rover can physically push SupportPrimary/PushFace in positive Y. The dynamic beam rests on the separate support, so removed contact lets gravity drop it.

rockfall.mechanism: A rover can push the dynamic RetainingObject/PushFace in positive Y, clearing the sloped ledge route for two dynamic loose rocks.

debris.mechanism: Two dynamic debris blocks visibly obstruct the drift.

rover_interactions.control_contract: Default robot is NVIDIA Nova Carter, an articulated wheeled rover. Future VLA/controller code must command wheel articulation; it must not teleport the chassis or call a collapse action.

roof_support_push.approach: Navigate the rover to the negative-Y side of SupportPrimary, then drive in positive Y into roof_push_face using ordinary chassis contact.
roof_support_push.success_signal: SupportPrimary has translated sufficiently in positive Y and BeamPrimary loses support contact.

rockfall_release.approach: Navigate to the negative-Y side of RetainingObject, then drive in positive Y into rock_retainer_push_face.
rockfall_release.success_signal: RetainingObject clears the ledge route and the loose rocks may roll under gravity.

debris_clearance.approach: Drive into either debris rigid body using the rover chassis; there is no special trigger.
debris_clearance.success_signal: Debris changes pose or clears the intended travel corridor.

safe_override_operations: Move or set kinematic state of SupportPrimary in a stronger experiment/session layer.
Adjust mass, friction/contact material, and rigid-body attributes of listed interactive prims.
Move RetainingObject or perturb Rock01/Rock02 in an experiment layer.
Move/reorient /World/Robot or replace only its reference with a compatible robot asset.
Add approved experiment objects under /World/FailureZones or a dedicated experiment scope.
immutable_base_policy: Do not write experiments back into mine_world.usda or its component asset layers; compose stronger override/session layers.
